schema:description:
This collection contains a selection of titles from the [LGBTQIA+ History and Culture Collection](https://library.ucdavis.edu/archives-and-special-collections/our-collections/book-pamphlet-collections/gay-and-lesbian-history-and-culture-collection/)

Digitization of these titles was supported by a California State Library LGBTQ+ History Grant.

The library catalog records for these titles are:

- [*Ah Men : Shop for Men*](https://search.library.ucdavis.edu/permalink/01UCD_INST/1mhgd8s/alma990020850190403126)
- [*Davis Voice*](https://search.library.ucdavis.edu/permalink/01UCD_INST/11htace/alma990031536860403126)
- [*Magpie*](https://search.library.ucdavis.edu/permalink/01UCD_INST/11htace/alma990021180590403126)
- [*Magpie of California*](https://search.library.ucdavis.edu/permalink/01UCD_INST/11htace/alma990031739520403126)
- [*Male Express*](https://search.library.ucdavis.edu/permalink/01UCD_INST/11htace/alma990020744740403126) *(San Francisco and Los Angeles editions)*
- [*Male Express*](https://search.library.ucdavis.edu/permalink/01UCD_INST/11htace/alma990037731190403126) *(Northern California and Southern California editions)*
- [*Out Loud*](https://search.library.ucdavis.edu/permalink/01UCD_INST/11htace/alma990025346820403126)
- [*This Month on the River*](https://search.library.ucdavis.edu/permalink/01UCD_INST/11htace/alma990020753410403126)

Issues of the title, *Mom Guess What*, are available [here.](https://digital.ucdavis.edu/collection/ark:/87293/d3bc3t533)
